scope.summary: Fix CRM capability descriptors so each capability preserves its own bounded-context resource model instead of inheriting the opportunity context.
explicit_non_claims: No GraphQL surface, dependency, schema, generated artifact, workflow, or shared CI config is introduced.
No production listener, persistence adapter, billing runtime, quota runtime, or regional control-plane runtime is claimed.
The change is limited to the CRM revenue app domain model and its Buck2 integration test.

criteria.control_plane_api: yellow: REST/gRPC/AsyncAPI scaffold exists; no live listener claimed
criteria.resource_model: green-after-change: account-master, opportunity, quote, campaign, and service-case descriptors map to distinct bounded contexts
criteria.tenant_project_account_isolation: yellow: fail-closed authz seam exists; this change removes descriptor collapse that could blur resource scope
criteria.iam_authz_policy: yellow: Cedar/authz port scaffold exists per ADR-0603
criteria.quota_capacity: yellow: manifest capacity model exists; no runtime enforcement claimed
criteria.billing_metering: red: no CRM-specific metering runtime in this slice
criteria.audit_event_trail: yellow: EVT-CRM event names in manifest; no runtime emission claimed
criteria.observability_slos: yellow: OpenSLO and dashboard artifacts exist; no runtime SLO evidence claimed
criteria.regional_cell_residency: yellow: manifest cell/residency posture exists; no runtime shard controller claimed
criteria.backup_restore_rollback: yellow: manifest DR metadata exists; no runtime drill evidence claimed
criteria.security_threat_model: yellow: ADR-0603 covers fail-closed authz; no new reachable edge
criteria.compliance_evidence: yellow: applicable packs listed in manifest; no regulator packet changed
criteria.sdk_api_ergonomics: yellow: typed Rust descriptor API exists; this change makes it semantically faithful
criteria.operational_runbooks: yellow: CRM runbooks exist; no runbook change required for this domain-local model fix

facets.F1_correctness: CapabilityDescriptor::descriptors now derives bounded_context from the capability instead of stamping every descriptor as Opportunity.
facets.F2_tests: Integration coverage asserts all five descriptors preserve capability, bounded_context, and TenantScoped invariant.
facets.F3_maintainability: The mapping is centralized on Capability::bounded_context and avoids duplicating descriptor construction logic.
facets.F4_compatibility: No wire contract, schema, generated face, or public API format changes; descriptor semantics become accurate.
facets.F5_security: Accurate resource context descriptors reduce cross-resource authorization and audit confusion; no credentials or unsafe code are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No tenant, customer, or personal data processing changes.
facets.F7_operability: Operators and future gates can rely on descriptor context when inspecting CRM capability/resource boundaries.
facets.F8_performance: The match is constant-time over an enum and only runs during descriptor construction.
facets.F9_compliance: No generated artifacts are hand-edited; GraphQL remains absent per ADR-0565 and api-contract-ssot-canonical.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a two-file Rust/test revert plus removal of this evidence file.
facets.F11_observability: The descriptor table is now a stable point for future audit/event/slo mapping by bounded context.
facets.F13_migration: Supports owned-stack CRM migration by preserving provider-neutral domain/resource boundaries before adapters are wired.

known_gaps: Remote oya-ci-required status is pending until PR creation.
Reviewer approval and merge admission are pending.
Runtime quota, billing, audit emission, regional placement, and backup/restore remain honest non-claims for this slice.
